        From eaca7ff61fc25e0f18f89d3a79bd7641ef229c8b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Frank Dittrich <frank.dittrich@mailbox.org>
Date: Sun, 20 Sep 2015 13:24:17 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] fuzz.c: fix a copy&paste error introduced in aeff562

---
 src/fuzz.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/fuzz.c b/src/fuzz.c
index de834aa13..21a52db60 100644
--- a/src/fuzz.c
+++ b/src/fuzz.c
@@ -613,7 +613,7 @@ int fuzz(struct db_main *db)
 	pristine_gecos = cfg_get_bool(SECTION_OPTIONS, NULL,
 	        "PristineGecos", 0);
 	single_skip_login = cfg_get_bool(SECTION_OPTIONS, NULL,
-		"PristineGecos", 0);
+		"SingleSkipLogin", 0);
 
 	if (options.flags & FLG_FUZZ_DUMP_CHK) {
 		from = -1;
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by a copy-and-paste error where the wrong configuration option name ("PristineGecos") was used instead of the intended option name ("SingleSkipLogin"). This led to the incorrect value being retrieved for the `single_skip_login` variable, potentially causing unintended behavior in the program.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by a copy-and-paste error where the wrong configuration option name ("PristineGecos") was used instead of the intended option name ("SingleSkipLogin"). This led to the incorrect value being retrieved for the `single_skip_login` variable, potentially causing unintended behavior in the program.
